# Metal Plate material

Original author: Rob Tuytel. Provider: Poly Haven.

Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/metal_plate
License: CC0 1.0, as listed at https://polyhaven.com/license (checked 2026-09-13).

These freely available texture maps are included in SpaceSurvival for the station deck. Poly Haven permits commercial use and redistribution under CC0. The original files remain unchanged; Unreal applies a restrained colour treatment and normal strength. SpaceSurvival does not claim authorship of these maps. The accompanying manifest records each original download URL and SHA-256.
